decisions.statement: A repository is served out of the store on the node the workload is pinned to.
A repository names in its own config the copy that repository mirrors to.
A hook is wired to a repository together with the copy that hook pushes to.
A repository with a mirror hook declares a destination.
A repository declaring a destination has a mirror hook.
A push is authenticated before git is reached at all.
A question asked from inside the cluster is answered without authentication.
The workload runs this code out of the source cache rather than an image layer.

definition: the repositories this system keeps, served over the network
